text:
Maya (CSM): quick pulse — ACME onboarding showing a higher error burden this week, can we get a short breakdown of 5xx / timeouts / rate_limit and the top failing URIs?
Jordan (SRE): on it. pulled last 24h: 5xx=182, timeouts=410, rate_limit=74. Hottest URIs: /v1/chat/stream, /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings/batch.
Maya (CSM): customer is mid-demo cadence; calling this P1 for ops/renewal risk context :eyes:
Lucas (ACME): seeing repeated 502s on /v1/chat/stream around 15:00-16:30 PST yesterday. Demo screenshots attached via DM.
Sam (CS): thanks Lucas. any obvious client-side retry storms?
Jordan (SRE): traces show a mix: long-running requests leading to server OOM on a subset of quantized nodes, plus a small pool of clients hitting the same model variant causing queueing. timeouts line up with cold-start spikes when autoscaler spins up.
eng-deploy-bot: Deployment event: rollback model-quant-v2 -> model-quant-v1 at 2025-11-12T16:20:36Z (reason: OOM regressions)
Jordan (SRE): mitigations in flight: 1) decrease default max_tokens to 512 for this account, 2) enable prefix KV caching on chat route, 3) tune autoscaler min replicas from 0->1 for the affected pool. expecting reduced timeouts within 30-45m.
Maya (CSM): practical ask for ACME: any temporary settings they can flip?
Jordan (SRE): ask them to set max_tokens=512 and backoff on 429/502 with exponential retry, or switch to the smaller model family (redwood/llama-13b-8q) for the demos. also recommend using the streaming endpoint to reduce long poll durations.
Riley (AM): logged a CRM note marking renewal watch. if no improvement in 24h we'll schedule an exec-touch.
Sam (CS): FYI spend went up ~28% last 24h vs baseline due to retries — tracking a separate spend alert for them. caching + dedupe would reduce that quickly.
Maya (CSM): I'll message Lucas with the workaround and request a quick test. scheduling a triage call for tomorrow 10:00 PT.
Lucas (ACME): will try the smaller model and update in this thread. thanks for the fast triage.
Jordan (SRE): follow-up: uploaded a short instrumented trace and a suggested client change snippet:
```
// suggestion: client-side
if (status === 502 || status === 503) {
  await backoff(2); // exponential
  retry();
}
set param max_tokens=512
```
Jordan (SRE): also putting a temporary routing rule to divert ACME traffic to the more stable pool while we stabilize quant nodes.
Maya (CSM): great. please post when the routing rule is active and when timeouts drop.
eng-deploy-bot: Routing rule applied: divert account:acme -> pool:stable-quant-01 (id: rr-775)
Jordan (SRE): initial telemetry: timeouts down ~60% after divest and cache enable. continuing to monitor.
Maya (CSM): perfect — I'll update the ACME success playbook and the renewal watch note. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Sam (CS): adding follow-up items: (1) confirm autoscaler min replica change persisted, (2) propose long-term fix for quant OOMs to infra backlog.
Riley (AM): noted, will add to account WAR room if we see regression.
Lucas (ACME): tested with smaller model, observed no 502s in 30m window. demos back to normal, thanks.
Maya (CSM): closing loop for now — keeping the triage call as scheduled in case of regression.
